parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the bucket, typically made of metal wire or rod, attached to the sides of the bucket for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can pivot or rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, typically cylindrical and made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is rigid and does not move independently; it serves as the structural component of the bucket.
